newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Smallholder up 5.52 pct on prospects.
newsitem.headline: Smallholder up 5.52 pct on prospects.

text.p: Shares of Tea Smallholder Factories Ltd rose 5.52 percent or 2.50 rupees to 47.75, in early Friday trade.
"There is new buying by retail and institutional investors as results in 1997 are expected to be very good, because the plantation sector is seen doing well," said a local broker.
Plantations, led by tea, are expected to report strong sales this year due to demand for Sri Lanka tea from the Commonwealth of Independent States and the Middle East.
The company processes tea bought from small cultivators.
